By leveraging tools like Cloudflare and NOWPayments, you can set up your digital store today and start receiving payments in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-9|crypto]]currency without the hurdles of traditional banking. content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can establish a fully functional digital commerce store using free Cloudflare infrastructure paired with crypto payment processing. Begin by creating a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site to host your digital products. Use NOWPayments to handle transactions, allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without the need for a middleman. This architecture not only empowers you to sell but also keeps the control firmly in your hands, ensuring that you own your customer data and product delivery.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

For immediate deployment, your minimum viable stack consists of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup allows you to showcase up to three digital products initially. The infrastructure is robust and free, which means you can start generating revenue without upfront costs. With no KYC requirements and instant payment confirmations, you can efficiently serve customers both locally and internationally.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on essential components for your online store. Don’t get bogged down with advanced marketing strategies or extensive product catalogs at the outset. Instead, prioritize setting up your payment gateway and hosting. You can always expand your offerings later. Make sure your product delivery mechanism is straightforward; you can use Google Drive for file storage, which integrates easily into your setup. This allows you to streamline operations and minimize distractions.
Own your customer data and product delivery without platform dependencies.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To execute your first transaction, ensure your NOWPayments account is configured correctly and linked to your digital storefront. Once that's done, perform a test transaction using USDT on the Tron network, which settles in under 60 seconds for fees below $0.10. This quick verification will demonstrate the seamless integration of your payment system. Promote your newly established store through social media to start attracting buyers immediately.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, finalize your product listings and ensure they are live on your platform. Promote your store actively on social media channels and consider utilizing Binance P2P to facilitate your transactions in local currencies like Pakistani rupees. Additionally, start compiling feedback from initial sales to refine your offerings. If you want a comprehensive setup, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for a complete suite of tools and templates to enhance your store.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Leverage blockchain payments for instant transactions and minimal fees.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Global access to digital product revenue is not contingent on where you are located — it is contingent on which infrastructure you build on. The sovereign stack works identically from Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Karachi, Dhaka, Harare, or Manila. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours under your accounts, tested on mainnet before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete build for self-deployers. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT. This variety allows you to cater to a broad audience, giving them the flexibility to pay in their preferred currency.

Yes, by using NOWPayments, you can easily accept payments from international customers. Cryptocurrencies facilitate global transactions, removing geographical barriers that hinder traditional payment methods.
